# bifrost_service (Resource)

Una herramienta del catálogo (postgres, redis, ...) añadida a un entorno. **Destruirla o reemplazarla borra los datos del entorno en ella**: la API lo exige con `confirm`; este recurso solo lo envía si `confirm_data_loss = true` ya está aplicado. Las opciones no se pueden cambiar sin recrear la herramienta, y la API no las devuelve al leer (no hay detección de drift de `options`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bifrost_service" "postgres" {
  app         = bifrost_app.tienda.name
  environment = bifrost_environment.prod.name
  service     = "postgres"

  # Para destruirlo (borra los datos) primero pon true y aplica:
  confirm_data_loss = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String)
- `environment` (String)
- `service` (String) Id de la herramienta en el catálogo (`postgres`, `redis`...).

### Optional

- `confirm_data_loss` (Boolean) Protección: debe estar en `true` (y aplicado) para poder destruir o reemplazar la herramienta, porque se borran los datos del entorno en ella.
- `dedicated` (Boolean) Instancia dedicada (si la herramienta lo admite).
- `options` (Map of String) Opciones de la herramienta (ver `GET /services/{id}`). Inmutables.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `resources` (List of String)
- `secret_name` (String) Secret de Kubernetes del entorno con los datos de conexión (los valores sensibles viven solo ahí).

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import bifrost_service.postgres tienda/prod/postgres
```
